semiconductor_relevance: High — SURAGUS GmbH specializes in non-destructive testing devices for semiconductor applications, particularly in thin-film and metal coating measurement.
summary: SURAGUS GmbH develops advanced non-destructive testing devices utilizing eddy current technology for the semiconductor industry. Their EddyCus® series offers inline and offline characterization solutions for thin-films, metal coatings, and bulk materials, ensuring quality assurance and defect identification.
